test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The vendor said that the apples were of __superior__ quality.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"superior"** means of higher quality or greater value. (श्रेष्ठ)

 
 
• **Example: **The **superior** craftsmanship of the watch made it highly sought after.
 
 
 
• **"Inferior" **refers to something that is of lower quality or lesser value. (निम्न)
 
 
• **Example: **The **inferior** materials used in the construction caused the building to deteriorate quickly.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'superior' **is **'inferior'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Small **(छोटा): Of limited size or extent.

 
 
• **Example:** The **small **puppy fit comfortably in her arms.
 
 
 
• **Excellent **(उत्कृष्ट): Extremely good; outstanding.
 
 
• **Example: **She received **excellent** grades in her final exams.
 
 
 
• **Distasteful** (अप्रिय): Causing dislike or aversion.
 
 
• **Example:** The** distasteful **smell made it hard to stay in the room.
 
 

4b:Td10,

The correct answer is: Option 3
